final: SELECT m.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income, 1.0 * SUM(i.amount) / SUM(SUM(i.amount)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM income AS i JOIN member AS mb ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id JOIN major AS m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id WHERE m.college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.college
